page.content:
Falcon king whose living image is the pharaoh.

How Horus connects

  • Character: Set — Horus contended with Set for Egypt's kingship.
  • Concept: Pharaoh — The living pharaoh is the earthly Horus.
  • Character: Isis — Isis conceived and hid the child Horus.
  • Event: Osiris myth — The myth ends in Horus' claim to the living throne.

What is Horus?

Horus, son of Isis and Osiris, avenges his father and wins the kingship from Set. The reigning pharaoh is Horus in the palace and Osiris only after death.

Key threads lead to Set, Pharaoh, Isis and Osiris myth.
